content: LWW CRDT tombstone pitfalls: deletes must carry their own newer version or a concurrent older update resurrects the value; premature tombstone GC causes resurrection (sup-kv keeps tombstones forever - decided); LWW reorders causally-related ops under clock skew (causal reverse anomaly, CockroachDB blog); deletes on a node with lagging clock lose to concurrent updates from fast-clock nodes. Suppression: delete = write of a tombstone record with fresh HLC version; create-if-absent must treat tombstoned key as absent; dump must persist tombstones or restart resurrects deleted keys.
